h1: Custom Cotton Sunscreen for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom cotton sunscreen for your team or event. Soft, breathable fabric sunscreen from Perfect Imprints. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Cotton sunscreen offers a unique alternative to traditional plastic bottles: soft fabric saturated with SPF that you can wipe on without sticky residue. Ideal for outdoor events, construction sites, or beach giveaways, these cotton-based sunscreens come in towels, tote bags, and even apparel like the Gildan Softstyle T-Shirt. Your logo can be screen printed or embroidered directly on the fabric, making them functional promotional items that protect skin and build brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom cotton sunscreen products including towels and tote bags with SPF protection
